summary: Implemented append-only trial ledger in court/ledger.py: frozen record types (SeConvention, Window, DeclaredProtocol, Series, HypothesisRecord, TrialRecord, VerdictRecord), LedgerCorruptionError, and Ledger with JSONL event log (hypothesis/trial/evaluation/verdict). Open replays into an in-memory index with torn-final-line truncate+fsync and mid-file/invariant failures as LedgerCorruptionError. Write path uses json.dumps(allow_nan=False)+flush+fsync; status is derived (registered/evaluated/judged); matrix returns label-for-label aligned float64 T×N columns in trial_ids order. tests/test_ledger.py covers happy path, line order, matrix alignment, §5.7 guards, and storage/replay (25 tests).

files_changed.purpose: Append-only JSONL trial ledger: records, durable append, replay, read surface, fail-closed guards per §5.7
Behavioral tests written first (TDD): contract, storage/replay, matrix, every §5.7 raise row
